12 January 2027

Monetary policy decisions

The Governing Council today decided to raise the three key ECB interest rates by 50 basis points.

The Governing Council will keep the key ECB interest rates sufficiently restrictive for as long as necessary to return inflation to target.

Key ECB interest rates

The interest rate on the main refinancing operations and the interest rates on the marginal lending facility and the deposit facility will be raised to 2.50%, 2.75% and 2.25% respectively, with effect from 13 January 2027.

Asset purchase programme (APP)

Under the APP, the Governing Council intends to stop reinvesting the proceeds from maturing securities from the beginning of February 2027.

Pandemic emergency purchase programme (PEPP)

The Governing Council intends to reinvest the principal payments from maturing securities purchased under the PEPP during the first half of 2027.

Targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO III)

The Governing Council decided to continue its targeted longer-term refinancing operations on unchanged terms, with banks free to repay early.

Monetary policy statement

Risks to the economic outlook for the euro area remain broadly balanced, although inflation risks are tilted to the upside.

The monetary policy press conference will take place today at 14:30 CET.

European Central Bank, 2027
